source.description:
Research finding: 'Cq – Stack Overflow for AI coding agents' got 225pts on HN — developers want searchable Q&A for agent patterns.

**Action items:**
1. Create ~/.xtrm/knowledge-base.jsonl for specialist Q&A logging
2. After each specialist run, log: problem_pattern, solution, files_changed, specialist, bead, success_bool
3. Add specialists search <query> to find past solutions
4. Wire into specialists run — check KB before starting, suggest past solutions
5. Add --share-solution flag to contribute anonymized patterns to community KB

**Example:**
```
specialists search 'npm install hangs'
# Returns: 3 past bug-hunt runs with similar symptoms + solutions
```

**Why this matters:** 
- Institutional memory across sessions
- Faster resolution for recurring problems
- Reduces duplicate specialist work

**Source:** last30days research on AI coding agents (HN: Cq project)
source.notes: Release triage 2026-05-04: valuable roadmap work, but not required for the next patch release. Defer until after release-critical bugfix/docs/packaging items land.
source.title: Create specialists Q&A knowledge base (pattern memory)
